rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) – 1-4 unit exemption
rules.requirement: The city's Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260, regulates rents and is enforced by the Office of Landlord Tenant Relations. Per this page, properties with 1-4 units are exempt, and other exemptions may be requested.
rules.coverage_text: Rental properties with 5 or more units; 1-4 unit properties are exempt.
rules.exemptions_text: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; the Ordinance provides other permitted exemptions that owners may request from the Office.

exemption_tests.description: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control.
Other permitted exemptions under the Rent Control Ordinance, requested via a Rent Control Exemption Request; criteria not stated on this page.

rules.citation: Jersey City Municipal Code, Chapter 260 (Rent Control Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span:
The Office of Landlord Tenant Relations administers and enforces the

rules.ambiguity_note: Summary web page; the actual cap amount or formula is not stated. Page lists a CPI chart and rent increase applications (capital improvement, hardship) only by title.
